name: motif_edit_affix_slot
description:
Edit an affix slot. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots or feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Use only if a slot is renamed or becomes optional or obligatory; otherwise move affixes with compose-edit-inflectional-affix. A slot is obligatory unless marked optional (guide suffix-prefix-slots). Changes whether an existing inflectional affix slot is optional, renames it, or both. The response lists every affix and template using the shared slot; Motif stages a Draft and never Applies it automatically. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-edit-affix-slot. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

target.description: Canonical id of the existing affix slot.

expected_optional.description: The optionality the project must currently have. Give with optional.

optional.description: The requested optionality. Give with expected_optional.

writing_system.description: Writing system of the slot name. Give with expected_name and name to rename.

expected_name.description: The slot name the project must currently have.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
